zh: 课表顶部更简洁，设置和导入步骤更清楚；编辑、返回和切换课表时更好地保留当前状态。
支持从教务更新当前课表，保留现有作息，并在更新前核对课程变化。
课表支持自定义背景，可调整浓淡、模糊、色彩和图片位置。
改善平板排版和桌面小组件的圆角、尺寸与显示，网格小组件支持跟随课程色条样式。
修正课表首次加载时误显示空课表、跳到错误周次的问题，并改进部分学校作息导入和课程提醒。
「我的」三列统计可以点击查看详情；关于页加入互动品牌卡，连续点击可发现一封信。
en: A cleaner timetable header and clearer settings and import steps, with better state preservation while editing, returning and switching timetables.
Refresh the current timetable from your school, keeping your daily time schedule and reviewing course changes before applying them.
Customize your timetable background with strength, blur, saturation and image-position controls.
Improved tablet layouts and widget corners, sizing and display. The weekly grid widget can follow the course color-bar style.
Fixed a temporary empty timetable and incorrect week during initial loading, and improved some school time-schedule imports and class reminders.
Tap the three statistics in My to explore details. Repeatedly tap the interactive brand card in About to discover a letter.
